description: Dominant composition is organized around a common circular/rotational centre.
Two or more visually meaningful concentric bands/rings organize the diagram.
Spokes, rays, wedges, or repeated radial divisions connect/partition centre and perimeter.
Human faces/heads/busts/figures occupy approximately four orthogonal/cardinal positions.
Human/anthropomorphic personifications are positioned radially around a centre.
Radial personifications face, point, blow, or otherwise orient materially toward the centre.
Visible breath/exhalation/air stream issues from a face or mouth.
A discrete visual object/emblem/body occupies the diagram centre.
Outer radial agents have a clear graphical relation directed toward/from the central object.
Visual organization prominently instantiates 4-, 8-, or 12-fold modularity.
Writing or repeated marks are arranged along circular/annular paths; content is not read.
Overall arrangement has approximate rotational symmetry around a common centre.
